title: Ananda Ragam
desc: A fisherman arranges to wed his sister to a wealthy man, despite having knowledge of her love affair with another man. He later discovers her husband's chronic illness, but it's too late.

title: Chinna Kannamma
desc: Aravind and Gayathri get married against their parents' wishes, and they live happily with their daughter, Saranya. However, when Gayathri dies, Aravind discovers that Saranya is not his daughter.

title: Kannadi Pookal
desc: A seven-year-old spends time happily with his father and stepmother. But with the birth of a new baby in the family, he is unable to tolerate the competition for parental love and kills the newborn.

title: Kodi Parakuthu
desc: A mafia leader tries to kill policeman Sivagiri, who took down his illegal businesses, with the help of a lookalike. Later, Sivagiri discovers that the leader is responsible for his father's death.
